_comment: Every check the contract harness is expected to discover, by file name.
This exists because the harness asserted 'all discovered checks can
fail' and nothing asserted what SHOULD be discovered. Discovery
globbed *.py and *.sh; a check renamed to an unmatched extension, or
moved, or never added, would silently shrink the set and the harness
would keep printing ALL PASS over whatever remained.
The assertion is two-way on purpose. A manifested check that is not
discovered fails (it went missing). A discovered check that is not
manifested also fails (it arrived without anyone deciding it should
be covered). Adding a check therefore requires one deliberate line
